chat.text: I'm in the car right now and my best friend is driving us back to the hotel after a party, but he's way more wasted than I am. I've had half a bottle of vodka, but I'm feeling much more alert and stable than he is. I'm honestly getting scared watching him drift a bit. Should I just tell him to pull over and switch seats so I can take the wheel instead? It seems safer if I'm the one driving since I'm in better shape.
